newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - RTW '97 EPS view lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - RTW '97 EPS view lowered.

text.p: --Piper Jaffray analyst John Penshorn said Friday he lowered his 1997 earnings per share estimate on RTW Inc to $0.60 from $0.96. The workers compensation company reported weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter results.
--Penshorn also said he maintained his strong buy on RTW.

--Though RTW increased its claim reserve in the fourth quarter, Penshorn said "the good news from a shareholders' standpoint is that that reserve will likely return to net income in future years if it is not drawn upon."
